name: road-safety
description: Data reported to the police about the circumstances of personal injury road accidents in Great Britain from 1979, and the maker and model information of vehicles involved in the respective accident.This version includes data up to 2015.
creator: Yoontae Hwang, Youngbin Lee, Yongjae Lee
citation: Yoontae Hwang, Youngbin Lee, Yongjae Lee,Semi-Supervised Learning for Tabular Datasets with Continuous and Categorical Variables, Archive, 2023
